data.assessment: On-time deliveries are 121.8 of 132.2 orders (0.92), with no unfinished orders. The 10.4 late deliveries come mostly from pickup deadline misses (7.8 of them, matching A's 7.8 lates), and A, which never waits on the road, loses 1352 s to being blocked. B and C park on the road about 38–40 times each. C draws most of the release-deadline sanctions (penalty 14.8), but its parking costs the other companies, A above all, their on-time pickups.

proposals.title: Evict road-parked robots sooner: block_k 3 -> 2
proposals.rationale: A's lateness (7.8 pickup misses) follows its 1352 s of blocked time, while blocking_guard evicted only 2.8 times at a threshold of 3 waiting robots. Lowering the threshold to 2 should clear the central intersection sooner, which should cut blocked_s and raise A's on-time count and the town on-time count, with no change to the customer promise. A should vote yes. C will probably vote no because its eviction penalties rise. B is uncertain: it gains from less blocking but also parks on the road.
proposals.cadl:
# =====================================================================
# robot_town.cadl ─── ロボットの街：3 社の配送ロボットが道路を共有する
#
# 道路網はラズパイマウスのシミュレータと同じ 11 ノード・17 エッジ。
# 3 社（A / B / C）が 2 台ずつロボットを走らせ、ノードは 1 台ずつしか
# 使えない。仕事のないロボットは車庫に戻るか、道路上（中央の交差点 8）
# に止まって次の注文を待つ。止まったロボットは他社の通行をふさぐ。
#
# `# @amend:<名前>` が付いた行は、改正してよいパラメータ。どの層（規則・
# 契約）に属し、どこまで動かしてよいかは constitution.yaml が決める。
# 委員会（COUNCIL）が自分で改正できるのは規則の層だけで、契約の層を
# 変えるには人間の判断が要る。
# =====================================================================

sos:
  name: "RobotTown"
  type: Collaborative             # 独立した 3 社が共通の規則を決める
  version: "1.0.0"

  context:
    environment:
      num_robots:   6
      num_companies: 3
      time_step_ms: 1000

  actors:
    - id: TOWN_STEWARD
      role: "road_steward"
      autonomy: low
      capabilities: [assign_order, record_violation, evict]
      interface:
        input:  [order_request, position_report, node_released, rule_update]
        output: [order_assignment, eviction_notice, regime_notice, violation_report]

    - id: "ROBOT[1..N]"
      role: "delivery_robot"
      autonomy: high
      capabilities: [move, park, pickup, dropoff]
      interface:
        input:  [order_assignment, eviction_notice, regime_notice, amendment_proposal]
        output: [position_report, node_released, ballot]

    - id: COUNCIL
      role: "rule_amendment_body"
      autonomy: medium
      capabilities: [propose_amendment, tally_ballots]
      interface:
        input:  [violation_report, ballot]
        output: [amendment_proposal, rule_update]

  contracts:
    # ── 顧客への約束：注文 1 件ごとのインスタンス（契約の層。人間が決める） ──
    - id: DELIVERY_SLA
      parties: [TOWN_STEWARD, "ROBOT[*]"]
      guarantee:
        - "pickup_time <= 120s"         # @amend:pickup_deadline
        - "dropoff_time <= 120s"        # @amend:dropoff_deadline
      lifecycle:
        states: [Assigned, PickedUp, Delivered, Late]
        initial: Assigned
        terminal: [Delivered, Late]
        transitions:
          - id: pickup
            from: Assigned
            to:   PickedUp
            on:   "ROBOT[i].status == PickedUp"
            deadline: 120s            # @amend:pickup_deadline
            on_violation: { transition: Late, severity: Major }
          - id: dropoff
            from: PickedUp
            to:   Delivered
            on:   "ROBOT[i].status == Delivered"
            deadline: 120s            # @amend:dropoff_deadline
            on_violation: { transition: Late, severity: Major }

    # ── 道路の使い方：道路上に止まるたびに 1 インスタンス ──
    - id: ROAD_USE
      parties: [TOWN_STEWARD, "ROBOT[*]", COUNCIL]
      guarantee:
        - "hold_time <= hold_limit"
      authority:
        decision_holder: COUNCIL
        beta: 0.5
        mode: "collective"
      information:
        alpha: 1.0                    # 規則と違反記録は全社に公開
      incentives:
        type: sanction
        lambda: 0.5                   # @amend:sanction_lambda
        rules:
          - "penalty(ROBOT[i], lambda) when overstay"
      lifecycle:
        states: [Holding, Overstay, Released, Evicted]
        initial: Holding
        terminal: [Released, Evicted]
        transitions:
          - id: release
            from: [Holding, Overstay]
            to:   Released
            on:   "ROBOT[i] -> TOWN_STEWARD : node_released"
            deadline: 60s             # @amend:hold_limit
            on_violation: { transition: Overstay, severity: Minor }
      monitors:
        - id: blocking_guard
          observe: "ROBOT[i].blocking"
          sampling: periodic(1000ms)
          rule: "ROBOT.blocking >= 2 AND state IN [Holding, Overstay]"  # @amend:block_k
          on_match: { transition: Evicted, severity: Major }

  # ── 運用モード：分散（各社が道路上で待つ）⇄ 集中（管理者が待避所を割り当てる） ──
  # 条件は 5 分ごとに、直前 5 分の観測で判定する。
  #   orders_in_window : 3 社の注文の合計件数
  #   blocked_pct      : ロボットが止まっているロボットにふさがれていた時間の割合（%）
  # 集中管理は交差点をふさがれない反面、エッジを 1 台ずつ割り当てるので、
  # 注文が非常に多いと許可待ちが積み重なる。そのときだけ分散に戻す。
  transitions:
    - from: DISTRIBUTED
      to: CENTRALIZED
      condition: "orders_in_window < 22"      # @amend:to_central
      protocol: SWITCH
      safety_invariant: "robots_on_road == 0"
    - from: CENTRALIZED
      to: DISTRIBUTED
      condition: "orders_in_window >= 26"     # @amend:to_distributed
      protocol: SWITCH

  protocols:
    - id: SWITCH
      trigger: "regime_condition_holds"
      steps:
        - "TOWN_STEWARD -> ROBOT[*] : regime_notice"
        - "ROBOT[*] -> TOWN_STEWARD : node_released"
        - "TOWN_STEWARD : activate_regime"
    - id: AMEND
      trigger: "period_end"
      steps:
        - "TOWN_STEWARD -> COUNCIL : violation_report"
        - "COUNCIL -> ROBOT[*] : amendment_proposal"
        - "ROBOT[*] -> COUNCIL : ballot"
        - "COUNCIL : tally_ballots"
        - "COUNCIL -> TOWN_STEWARD : rule_update"

  metrics:
    - id: on_time_deliveries
      formula: "count(Delivered)"
      target: ">= 0.9 * count(orders)"
    - id: blocked_time
      formula: "sum(blocked_robot_seconds)"
      target: "<= 600s"
assumptions: A's pickup misses are caused mainly by being blocked at the central intersection by B/C robots parked there.
Eviction physically frees the node rather than only adding a penalty.
Companies vote on their own utility (on-time count minus penalties) as the constitution states.
unknowns: Whether more frequent evictions send B/C robots on longer trips to their garages, which would delay their own pickups.
Whether B's gain from less blocking outweighs its extra eviction penalties, which decides whether the vote reaches quorum.
Whether the improvement reaches the 1.0 min_improvement threshold.

predictions.note: A is the most blocked company.

predictions.note: A pays no penalties and gains on-time deliveries.

predictions.note: C bears most of the added eviction penalties.

proposals.title: Relax the pickup promise: pickup_deadline 120 s -> 150 s (contract)
proposals.rationale: Pickup deadline misses (7.8) cause three quarters of the 10.4 late deliveries, almost all at A, which has the lowest on-time rate (0.84). Allowing 150 s from order to pickup should turn most of these near-misses into on-time deliveries, raising on_time_deliveries and A's rate. The SLA-independent p95_wait_s (188 s) and unfinished (0) should not change, so customers would not wait longer, but they would receive a weaker promise. All three companies should vote yes because no one's utility falls.

proposals.why_human: This changes the customer contract (DELIVERY_SLA), and customers do not vote. It weakens the pickup promise by 30 s. Per K1, the human must weigh the measured customer impact (p95_wait_s, max_wait_s, unfinished) against the gain in on-time count. The physical fix to blocking (block_k) may be preferable to loosening the promise first.
assumptions: Most of A's pickup misses fall within 30 s of the current 120 s deadline.
Robot dispatch behavior does not slow down when given a looser deadline, so actual waits stay the same.
unknowns: The distribution of actual pickup times above 120 s; misses beyond 150 s remain late.
Whether customers value the 120 s promise more than a higher on-time count.
